source.name: Astra Vale Rain-derived round-004 static warrior source
source.foundation: Rain v3 by Blender Studio / Blender Foundation

passedChecks: Diagnostic face, hands, feet, and grip coverage
failedChecks: Both visible hands physically enclose the hilt
Functional weapon scale, mount, grip, and contact
Premium material separation without plastic, chrome, or clipping
Combat line of action, balance, and attack intent
visualReview.singleBiggestGap: The delivered costume's construction language is still a toy-like procedural slab-and-tube assembly rather than believable, layered, worn, functional AAA warrior gear.
secondaryGaps: The lower hand is not an unambiguous complete enclosure and the grip contains occluding or intersecting hardware
The oversized flat weapon and crude mount read as presentation geometry
Glossy homogeneous response collapses cloth, leather, and metal into plastic or chrome
The upright crossed-foot combat pose has no committed attack intent or readable line of action
Every FBX has one nonportable unresolved texture reference
Generated artifact bytes are not reproducible even though canonical geometry and decoded imagery are effectively stable

mechanicalValidation.interpretation: Geometry, broad bounds, triangle counts, and source renderer-name removal pass. The supplied validator does not inspect texture resolution after FBX import.

reproducibility.interpretation: The authored blend, five FBXs, nine PNGs, audit JSON, and reimport JSON differ byte-for-byte across isolated runs. Canonical world-space geometry, oriented topology, UV mapping, materials, assignments, transforms, counts, and bounds match; decoded image drift is visually negligible.

integrityFindings.validatorBlindSpot: The validator checks file-backed images only in the authored blend and therefore reports PASS despite every FBX carrying one broken absolute texture reference.
integrityFindings.auditRegenerationGap: Five repository audit sections were added outside the generator with no frozen postprocessor: build_receipt, clean_reimport_validation, diagnostic_images, known_gaps, and warnings.

nextRound.target: Replace the procedural costume pipeline with a cohesive, professionally authored, lawfully sourced warrior character or costume whose construction, wear, material history, fastening logic, and silhouette are already credible before any adaptation.
